title: Route Journal
tagline: A keyless Sepolia desk that files a Uniswap v3 swap intent and executes it from a static page.
problem: Hackathon DeFi demos either mock swaps or depend on sponsor API keys, hosted backends, and multi-contract stacks that cannot be finished on GitHub Pages. Teams also lack a public, on-chain record of what route was intended versus what actually settled.
solution: Route Journal is one OpenZeppelin v5 contract plus a Vite app. A trader files token, fee, amount, and min-out; the page quotes the canonical v3 pool over a public Sepolia RPC; execute pulls tokens and calls the official SwapRouter02. A GitHub Action republishes journal events as static JSON so the demo needs no server and no paid key.

target_tracks.why: Start-fresh build, not the Continuity pool. The product integrates Uniswap AMM v3 as the execution venue: pool identity, on-chain quote, and SwapRouter02 settlement are load-bearing, and the repo can ship FEEDBACK.md plus the required feedback-form link.
target_tracks.integration: Vendored IUniswapV3Pool and SwapRouter/Quoter interfaces; frontend computes the v3 pool address and eth_calls slot0 plus QuoterV2; RouteJournal.executeIntent settles via exactInputSingle on Sepolia. No Uniswap API key.

contract.name: RouteJournal
contract.description: Owner-administered journal of swap intents. Stores trader, tokenIn, tokenOut, fee, amountIn, amountOutMin, deadline, and status. Execution escrows the input token, approves the owner-set SwapRouter02, and records amountOut. Rejects expired, cancelled, or foreign intents. Pausable. USD notion is display-only off-chain, not enforced.

functions.purpose: Owner sets the official Sepolia SwapRouter02 after verifying the Uniswap deployment list. Required because the constructor cannot take arguments.

functions.signature: fileIntent(address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint24 fee, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, uint256 deadline)
functions.purpose: Msg.sender files a pending intent. Tokens stay in the wallet until execute.
Intent owner cancels a still-pending intent.
Intent owner only. SafeERC20 pull, approve router, exactInputSingle, mark executed with amountOut, refund unused input.
Returns the stored intent for the static UI.

events: IntentFiled(uint256 indexed id, address indexed trader, address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint24 fee, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, uint256 deadline)
contract.notes: constructor MUST take no arguments (owner = msg.sender)

features: Connect an injected wallet on Ethereum Sepolia via viem and show chain metadata from the free Blockchain Lab chains JSON.
Build a v3 route: token pair, fee tier, pool address from the v3 CREATE2 formula, slot0 and liquidity, QuoterV2 eth_call for amountOut.
File, cancel, and execute an intent; surface min-out slippage and router address before the irreversible call.
List intents from contract reads and from the committed activity.json feed.
Unit and ABI helpers for amounts and SwapRouter calldata, with explorer links and a short architecture note for judges.

automation.name: journal-feed
automation.purpose: workflow_dispatch and a six-hour cron: cast/forge reads IntentFiled and IntentExecuted on the public Sepolia RPC and commits activity.json for GitHub Pages. No API key.

flowchart LR

  App --> Journal[RouteJournal]
  App --> Pool[Uniswap v3 pool]
  App --> Quoter[QuoterV2]

  App --> LabAPI[blockchainlab-api chains JSON]

bill_of_blocks.how_used: Repo layout and Foundry+OZ v5 test setup taken from the foundry-oz-tokens starter; RouteJournal is the single new contract, not a copy of the token kit.
README skeleton and docs/SUBMISSION.md checklist, including the Uniswap FEEDBACK.md pointer and line-of-code map.
Vendored IUniswapV3Pool and the PoolAddress CREATE2 formula so the app and tests identify the canonical pool without a factory call dependency beyond the known factory address.
Vendored ISwapRouter exactInputSingle and IQuoterV2 ABI used by executeIntent and by the browser eth_call quote.
Fee-tier and slippage field pattern from the open-source Uniswap interface, reimplemented in the Vite page rather than running that Next app.
Foundry test shape from the AMM labs: fork-free router mock plus a mainnet-fork optional test that is skipped in CI when no RPC secret is set.
forge test and cast log decoding in the journal-feed Action; no Foundry source is modified.
Client-side wei/decimal and ABI decode helpers copied into the static app for amount entry and router calldata preview.
Browser fetches the nightly chains dataset for chain id 11155111, public RPC hints, and explorer base URL. Demo does not use keyed datasets.

Uniswap API and CCA are unused; do not claim them. Submit the Uniswap Developer Feedback Form with the FEEDBACK.md URL before judging.
risks: Sepolia v3 liquidity is thin; execute can revert on amountOutMin even when the quote looked valid. The UI must show the quote block and let the user lower size.

SwapRouter02 and QuoterV2 addresses must be copied from Uniswap's current Sepolia deployment list into setRouter and the frontend config. A wrong constant would send approvals to the wrong contract, so the router starts unset and execute reverts until the owner sets it.
Public RPCs rate-limit eth_call and getLogs; the Action should paginate and the page should fall back to activity.json.
Only the Uniswap Foundation start-fresh stack prize is an honest fit. Other sponsor pools need keys, other chains, or continuity status this demo does not have.
